text: Testing playbook: capture the profile update, add role, roleid, is_admin, and plan fields one at a time, and read the user record back. Check the response for fields that hint at the model. Verify access to admin routes in a fresh session. Tools: Burp Repeater, two accounts, Python requests. Target phases: response inspection, field injection, persistence check, and admin-access confirmation.

metadata.title: Testing Profile Updates for Mass Assignment of Role Fields
metadata.lab_title: User role can be modified in user profile

text: Testing playbook: decode every cookie and classify it by business meaning, then mutate role-like values one at a time. Compare navigation and response content with a genuine administrator. Exercise the actions rather than stopping at the menu. Tools: browser devtools, Burp Suite, Python requests. Target phases: cookie inventory, value mutation, panel access, and action confirmation.

metadata.title: Testing Role Cookies for Client-Side Trust
metadata.lab_title: User role controlled by request parameter

text: Testing playbook: request documentation paths and parse any OpenAPI, Postman, or GraphQL schema found. Build the endpoint-by-method matrix and replay each operation with the weakest session available. Compare documented parameters with the fields the interface actually sends. Tools: Burp Suite, browser, jq. Target phases: documentation discovery, schema parsing, operation replay, and effect confirmation.

metadata.title: Testing Documented API Surfaces for Missing Authorization
metadata.lab_title: Exploiting an API endpoint using documentation

text: Testing playbook: capture the checkout GET and POST, diff the response fields against the rendered form, then add each unrendered field to the POST one at a time. Compare the returned total with the catalogue total. Check nested objects and array-valued discount fields. Tools: Burp Repeater, two accounts, Python requests. Target phases: response inspection, field injection, total comparison, and order confirmation.

metadata.title: Testing Checkout Payloads for Hidden Discount Fields
metadata.lab_title: Exploiting a mass assignment vulnerability

text: Testing playbook: collect every API route from proxy history, then replay each with GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE. Inspect error messages to derive the accepted body shape, and watch for routes that answer 200 to an unexpected method. Tools: Burp Repeater, ffuf, Python requests. Target phases: route collection, method matrix, body derivation, and price-effect confirmation.

metadata.title: Testing Product API Routes Across All HTTP Methods
metadata.lab_title: Exploiting an unused API endpoint

text: Testing playbook: identify inputs that reach a server-side API, then inject encoded ampersands, fragments, and new parameter names one at a time. Read error messages for hints about the internal parameter set. Use a controlled account to observe effects safely. Tools: Burp Repeater, Collaborator, Python urllib. Target phases: input discovery, delimiter injection, parameter derivation, and effect confirmation.

metadata.title: Testing Server-Side Parameter Pollution in Composed Query Strings
metadata.lab_title: Exploiting server-side parameter pollution in a query string

text: Testing playbook: infer the internal path from timing and error differences, then inject traversal, encoded slashes, and query delimiters. Look for documentation or error output that names the internal routes and fields. Verify the effect on a controlled second account. Tools: Burp Repeater, ffuf, Python urllib. Target phases: path inference, traversal injection, route discovery, and effect confirmation.

metadata.title: Testing REST URL Composition with Traversal Sequences
metadata.lab_title: Exploiting server-side parameter pollution in a REST URL

text: Testing playbook: capture both login steps, identify every identity-bearing field, and substitute a second controlled account. Observe whose challenge is issued and whose code is accepted. Test counter resets by re-authenticating mid-attack. Tools: Burp Repeater, Turbo Intruder, two accounts. Target phases: field inventory, substitution, challenge confirmation, and counter-reset test.

metadata.title: Testing 2FA Challenge Binding Against Parameter Substitution
metadata.lab_title: 2FA broken logic

text: Testing playbook: complete only the first factor, then request protected pages and APIs directly. Compare with a fully verified session. Test back-button navigation and replayed requests from history. Tools: Burp Suite, browser, Python requests. Target phases: first-factor login, direct navigation, API replay, and access confirmation.

metadata.title: Testing Protected Routes After First-Factor Authentication Only
metadata.lab_title: 2FA simple bypass

text: Testing playbook: submit wrong codes and record the response, redirect, and any lockout. Determine whether the challenge rotates and whether a macro can refresh it. Test a bounded range, staying within a rate that avoids denial of service. Tools: Burp Intruder with macros, Turbo Intruder, Python requests. Target phases: challenge capture, rotation analysis, bounded sweep, and success confirmation.

metadata.title: Testing 2FA Attempt Limits with Automated Challenge Refresh
metadata.lab_title: 2FA bypass using a brute-force attack

text: Testing playbook: capture the confirmation request, then mutate the username, remove the token, and replay a consumed token. Check which field actually selects the account. Confirm the effect by logging in. Tools: Burp Repeater, two accounts, Python requests. Target phases: request capture, field mutation, token replay, and login confirmation.

metadata.title: Testing Reset Confirmation for Token and Identity Decoupling
metadata.lab_title: Password reset broken logic

text: Testing playbook: request a reset with Host, X-Forwarded-Host, and Forwarded headers pointing at a listener. Inspect the delivered email for the link host. Confirm the token works when redeemed from a different client. Tools: Burp Collaborator, mail client, Python requests. Target phases: header injection, email inspection, token capture, and reset confirmation.

metadata.title: Testing Reset Link Generation Against Host Header Injection
metadata.lab_title: Password reset poisoning via middleware

text: Testing playbook: capture the change request and mutate the username field. Compare responses for wrong, correct, and mismatched new-password pairs. Check whether success is distinguishable by status, redirect, or body. Run a bounded candidate list and confirm the change. Tools: Burp Intruder, two accounts, Python requests. Target phases: field mutation, oracle analysis, bounded guessing, and login confirmation.

metadata.title: Testing Password Change for Identity Substitution and Oracle Behaviour
metadata.lab_title: Password brute-force via password change

text: Testing playbook: change credential fields to arrays, objects, duplicate keys, and delimited strings. Observe whether the server evaluates multiple values and whether the limiter reacts. Compare response timing and redirect targets. Tools: Burp Repeater, Turbo Intruder, Python requests. Target phases: payload mutation, parser behaviour, limiter check, and login confirmation.

metadata.title: Testing Login Parsers for Multi-Value Credential Payloads
metadata.lab_title: Broken brute-force protection, multiple credentials per request

text: Testing playbook: trigger the block to learn the threshold, then interleave successful logins on a second account and see whether the counter clears. Track per-account state across source addresses. Tools: Burp Intruder with a macro, Turbo Intruder, Python requests. Target phases: threshold discovery, interleaving, counter observation, and success confirmation.
